prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Spotlight Layout for Adoption Certificate: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a spotlight layout to highlight the pet preview and official sign-off.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Pet Style Selector Screen Before Path Choice: Insert a visual pet style preference screen right after the story screen to build instant visual interest.
   config: {"new_pet_style_selector": {"headline": "Choose Your Pet Style", "body": "Select the visual theme for your desktop companion.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "new_pet_style_selector", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Live Pet Preview Component for Custom Creation: Replace the static photo upload interface with an interactive live pet preview rendering element.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"replace": {"photo_upload": [{"role": "photo_upload", "type": "preview", "asset": "asset:live_pet_render", "style": "playful"}]}}}
3: [home, redesign] Stage Layout Companion Animation for Waiting Screen: Redesign the waiting screen into a full stage layout featuring an animated pet mascot companion.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:companion_stage_anim", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Warning Hint on Sign-In: Display a hint on sign-in warning users to use their existing account to avoid pet resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in with your existing account keeps all your pets and progress safe."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] Desktop Companionship Story Copy Reframing: Update the story screen copy to focus directly on having a live interactive pet on your desktop.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Your Always-On Desktop Companion", "body": "Bring a friendly pet to life right on your desktop to keep you company, play, and interact throughout your day."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Verification Badge Incentive: Add an official adoption verification badge component on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Shortcut Tip Carousel on Waiting Screen: Add a tip carousel component to the waiting screen explaining how to interact with the pet once loaded.
   config: {"waiting": {"components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Quick Tip: Right-click your desktop pet anytime to bring up controls or chat.", "style": "calm"}]}}
8: [finish, layout] Two-Column Layout for Home Intro Screen: Switch the home intro screen layout to a two-column structure separating the welcome greeting from control actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column"}}
9: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Temperament Selection Screen: Insert a pet temperament selection screen prior to adoption certificate signing.
   config: {"new_pet_temperament": {"headline": "Select Pet Temperament", "body": "Choose whether your desktop companion is energetic, calm, or playful.", "layout": "centered"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_pet_temperament", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout maintains all required elements and functionality.
Adding a new screen inside onboarding is explicitly allowed.
Replacing the photo upload interface with a static preview component removes the photo upload functionality, losing the screen's required job.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout and adding visual components inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding an informative sign-in hint does not violate fair design or any base rules.
Updating story copy to introduce the desktop pet companion fulfills the screen's job.
Adding an official adoption badge component to the certificate screen is permitted.
Adding helpful desktop shortcut tips to the waiting screen is allowed.
Redesigning the home intro layout is allowed as home intro is part of onboarding.
Inserting a new pet temperament screen into the onboarding flow is allowed.
